top_signals.title: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks
top_signals.summary: Iran has escalated its strikes on commercial ships transiting Hormuz in recent weeks, as it tries to choke off a rebound in crude oil exports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FMC Proposes Remedies to Counteract Unfavorable Spanish Shipping Conditions
top_signals.summary: After investigating reports of restrictive port practices by the Government of Spain, the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) has determined that Spain has created unfavorable shipping conditions against U.S.-flagged vessels. As a result, the…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasury says largest U.S. banks let politics influence who received banking services
top_signals.summary: New Treasury Department findings may lend weight to President Donald Trump’s long-running grievance that major banks have discriminated against conservatives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hex and PulseChain founder Richard Heart detained in Istanbul: reports
top_signals.summary: Turkish reports say $4 million and 64 watches were seized. Police have yet to confirm Heart’s detention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: PMorganChase Announces New Leadership for $1.5 Trillion Security and Resiliency Initiative
top_signals.summary: JPMorganChase has added two senior leaders to support shipbuilding and maritime efforts within its Security and Resiliency Initiative (SRI), the firm's $1.5 trillion, 10-year effort focused on strengthening industries critical to economic and national security.
